parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: EventTransferType
parameters.description:
The event generation method. Valid values:

- default: the default built-in method

- singleToSingle: An event is generated for each alert.

- allToSingle: An event is generated for all alerts in an epoch.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- desc: descending

- asc: ascending

parameters.name: OrderField
parameters.description:
The field to sort the rules by. Valid values:

- GmtModified: Sorts by modification time.

- Id: Sorts by rule ID. This is the default value.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of the threat analysis feature is located. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong)

- ap-southeast-1: assets outside China

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the perspective of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. The name can contain only letters, digits, underscores (\_), and periods (.).

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:

- predefine: predefined

- customize: custom

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The rule status. Valid values:

- 0: initial

- 10: testing with simulated data

- 15: testing with production data

- 20: testing with production data is complete

- 100: published

parameters.name: ThreatLevel
parameters.description:
The threat level. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

- serious: high

- suspicious: medium

- remind: low
